_note: projects-from-planninq-on-the-case (dossiq#3190). The case declares planninq's projects leaf, so a handler sees and starts the projects run for a case without dossiq querying planninq's register. Planninq owns projects and their hand-over of files to the case; dossiq holds no copy. `linkedTypes` is a LIST and fragments concatenate lists, so this adds the one id.
